raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Enable the existing `--disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup host_pool` option and automatically selected host-pool backup on Ascend NPU decode servers.

When a decode server uses host-pool backup without enabling hierarchical caching or decode KV offload, it still needs Ascend HiCache IO and memory-layout settings. These settings were only applied to hierarchical caching and KV offload. In addition, `page_first_direct` host buffers used the wrong dimension when building per-layer views, which could cause incorrect KV transfers or out-of-bounds indexing when the host pool has fewer pages than model layers.

## Modifications

- **`python/sglang/srt/hardware_backend/npu/utils.py`**: Apply the Ascend HiCache configuration when the server role is `decode` and the retraction backend is explicitly `host_pool` or unset for automatic selection. This selects `kernel_ascend` IO and the existing NPU layout selection; MHA uses `page_first_direct`.
- **`python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/pool_host/mha.py`**: Build per-layer views for `page_first_direct` by transposing the page and layer dimensions, as already done for `page_first`.
- **`test/registered/unit/npu/test_decode_retraction_backup.py`**: Add eight registered NPU tests covering configuration selection, FIA and non-FIA buffers, exact KV restoration into newly allocated device pages, partial pages, exhausted host capacity, and the `none` backend.

## Accuracy Tests

On the rebased head `ac5429a08b`:

- All **8 NPU unit tests passed** in `sglang-wt-a3`, including actual NPU KV backup/restore with both `cpu_tensor` and `host_pool`.
- `git diff --check` and Python syntax checks passed.

Integration validation before the rebase used actual **Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct** weights with BF16, MHA, TP=1, Ascend transport, and eager prefill/decode. Each scenario used four concurrent requests generating 64 tokens:

| Scenario | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Baseline | All four requests completed without retraction. |
| `cpu_tensor` | All four requests completed after eight retractions; generated token IDs matched the baseline exactly. |
| `host_pool` | All four requests completed after eight retractions; generated token IDs matched the baseline exactly. |
| Automatic selection | Resolved to `host_pool`; all four requests completed after eight retractions and matched the baseline exactly. |
| `none` | Retracted requests returned HTTP 503; the remaining request completed. |
| Exhausted host pool | The request that could not be backed up returned HTTP 500; the other three completed. |

All six decode instances remained healthy after their requests. These PD integration scenarios have not been rerun after the rebase.

Shared CPU cache regression tests before the rebase: **32 passed, 1 skipped**, with the optional NPU-only Mamba copy kernel disabled for CPU fixtures. This fixture adjustment was not used for the NPU unit tests or PD integration runs. Ruff and isort also passed before the rebase.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No throughput or latency benchmark was run. Validation focused on KV preservation and request recovery; integration coverage is limited to the MHA, TP=1, eager configuration described above.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

-    # handles hierarchical cache / decode-offload configs
+    # Backup-only decode retraction also builds a HiCache host pool. The

         cfg.enable_hierarchical_cache
         or cfg.disaggregation_decode_enable_offload_kvcache
+        or (
+            cfg.disaggregation_mode == "decode"

+        )
     ):
         declare_resolution(
             args,

@@ -234,7 +234,7 @@ def _initialize_transfer_views(self, buffer_info, write_back_staging) -> None:
             # transfer kernels address the fused buffer directly instead.
             self.k_data_refs = []
             self.v_data_refs = []
-        elif self.layout == "page_first":
+        elif self.layout in ("page_first", "page_first_direct"):
             # Transpose [page, layer, ...] -> [layer, page, ...] to get per-layer views
             # This swaps strides without copying data
             k_transposed = self.k_buffer.transpose(0, 1)

@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+"""NPU end-to-end tests for the `--disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup` feature.
+
+These tests launch a real prefill + decode + load balancer PD pipeline on Ascend
+NPU with the decode side configured with `--disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup
+host_pool`. They verify:
+
+1. The PD pipeline serves requests end to end: prefill handles the prompt and the
+   decode side, operating under host_pool KV retraction backup, produces the final
+   completion with the correct text.
+2. The NPU wiring for the host-pool backup is active on the decode server: the
+   running server reports `hicache_io_backend == kernel_ascend` and
+   `hicache_mem_layout == page_first_direct`, which is exactly what the NPU backend
+   applies when the decode side uses (explicit or inferred) host_pool retraction
+   backup.
+"""
+
+import logging
+import os
+import unittest
+from typing import Dict
+
+# The PD disaggregation backend must be the Ascend engine (not the mooncake
+# default in environ.py) to run the NPU host_pool retraction backup path.
+# ``setdefault`` keeps any value set externally (e.g. by the CI runner) in force.
+os.environ.setdefault("SGLANG_TEST_PD_DISAGG_BACKEND", "ascend")
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.bench_serving import get_tokenizer
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import (
+    LLAMA_3_2_1B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.server_fixtures.disaggregation_fixture import (
+    PDDisaggregationServerBase,
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(est_time=400, suite="base-b-test-17-npu-a3")
+register_npu_ci(est_time=400, suite="nightly-17-npu-a3", nightly=True)
+
+# Explicitly selected on the decode server; the NPU backend then forces
+# hicache_io_backend=kernel_ascend and hicache_mem_layout=page_first_direct.
+DECODE_RETRACTION_BACKUP = "host_pool"
+
+
+class TestPDDecodeRetractionBackup(PDDisaggregationServerBase):
+    """Testcase: E2E PD serving on NPU with --disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup
+    host_pool, plus NPU host-pool wiring assertions on the decode server.
+
+    [Test Category] Functional
+    [Test Target] PD disaggregation on NPU
+    --disaggregation-mode; --disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup;
+    --disaggregation-bootstrap-port;
+    """
+
+    extra_prefill_args = [
+        "--attention-backend",
+        "ascend",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.6",
+        "--disable-cuda-graph",
+    ]
+    extra_decode_args = [
+        "--attention-backend",
+        "ascend",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        "0.6",
+        "--disable-cuda-graph",
+        "--num-reserved-decode-tokens",
+        "128",
+        "--disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup",
+        DECODE_RETRACTION_BACKUP,
+    ]
+
+    # One engine per device. In CI these overrides are replaced by the runner's own
+    # device assignment; locally they pin prefill/ decode to two idle Ascend chips.
+    # Each side sees exactly one visible device, so gpu index 0 maps to it.
+    prefill_tp_size = 1
+    decode_tp_size = 1
+    decode_base_gpu_id = 0
+    extra_prefill_env = {
+        "ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES": os.getenv("PD_PREFILL_DEV", "1"),
+        "ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL": os.getenv(
+            "ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL", "tcp://127.0.0.1:24667"
+        ),
+    }
+    extra_decode_env = {
+        "ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES": os.getenv("PD_DECODE_DEV", "8"),
+        "ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL": os.getenv(
+            "ASCEND_MF_STORE_URL", "tcp://127.0.0.1:24667"
+        ),
+    }
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        # The repo constant points at the CI model cache. It can be overridden via
+        # env for local runs where the cache path is not populated.
+        cls.model = (
+            os.getenv("SGLANG_TEST_WEIGHTS_PATH") or LLAMA_3_2_1B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH
+        )
+        cls.tokenizer = get_tokenizer(cls.model)
+        cls.launch_all()
+
+    def send_request(
+        self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 100, temperature: float = 0.0
+    ) -> Dict:
+        response = requests.post(
+            f"{self.lb_url}/generate",
+            json={
+                "text": prompt,
+                "sampling_params": {
+                    "temperature": temperature,
+                    "max_new_tokens": max_tokens,
+                },
+            },
+            timeout=120,
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            response.status_code,
+            200,
+            f"Request failed: {response.status_code} - {response.text}",
+        )
+        return response.json()
+
+    def test_generate_through_pd_pipeline(self):
+        """A request routed through prefill -> decode completes with output.
+
+        With host_pool retraction backup the decode server reserves a HiCache host
+        pool to preserve KV across retractions. A successful, non-empty completion
+        confirms the PD pipeline (and the NPU host-pool wiring on decode) is alive.
+        """
+        prompt = "The capital of France is"
+        response = self.send_request(prompt, max_tokens=96)
+        text = response["text"]
+        logging.warning(f"E2E generate output: {text!r}")
+        self.assertTrue(isinstance(text, str) and text.strip())
+        # With host_pool retraction backup the decode side may drain its batch when
+        # the reserved prefill KV is retracted to the host pool and re-fetched, so the
+        # completion can legitimately end with either `stop` (EOS) or `length`
+        # (max_new_tokens reached). Both are valid proof the PD pipeline is alive.
+        self.assertIn(
+            response["meta_info"]["finish_reason"]["type"], ("stop", "length")
+        )
+
+    def test_decode_side_npu_host_pool_config_resolved(self):
+        """The decode server must resolve the NPU host-pool wiring.
+
+        The running decode server was launched with
+        --disaggregation-decode-retraction-backup=host_pool, so the NPU backend must
+        have forced kernel_ascend IO and page_first_direct layout. Assert those
+        resolved values via /server_info.
+        """
+        info = requests.get(self.decode_url + "/server_info", timeout=30).json()
+        self.assertEqual(
+            info.get("disaggregation_decode_retraction_backup"), "host_pool"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            info.get("hicache_io_backend"),
+            "kernel_ascend",
+            f"NPU host-pool backup must use kernel_ascend IO, got {info.get('hicache_io_backend')}",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            info.get("hicache_mem_layout"),
+            "page_first_direct",
+            f"NPU host-pool backup must use page_first_direct layout, got {info.get('hicache_mem_layout')}",
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
